checks: absence produces no deployment success claim
valid record and checkpoint preserve bytes/inodes/modes
foreign release, unknown fields and nonliteral values refused
null, duplicate keys, malformed, oversized and nonfinite JSON refused
strict checkpoint schema and phase enumeration
symlink, hardlink, mode and FIFO refused before content read
rejection output does not expose private marker
runtime arguments refused before contract/state reads
limits: Absence of failure.json is not proof of deployment success or absence of an uncompleted failure.json.next publication.
The two atomic files are read independently while the controller may advance; this is not a locked snapshot of its state.
An unsafe file or concurrent replacement yields only FIRST_RELEASE_FAILURE_OBSERVATION_REFUSED; no raw diagnostic is exported.
The immutable controller003 code must have been imported before this probe is usable.
scope: Read-only fixed controller003 failure projection; real synthetic filesystem tests, no VPS call
